About the Firm

About VSK & Associates

VSK & Associates was founded by Mr. Vaibhav S. Kulkarni, Advocate, in 2022. The firm has offices in Mumbai and New Delhi.

The firm advises Indian and foreign clients, including Fortune 500 companies, on corporate and commercial matters, regulatory compliance, foreign investment and entry into India, aviation, and the resolution of disputes before courts and arbitral tribunals.

What We Do

Practice Areas

Corporate & Commercial

Company formation and structuring, shareholder and joint venture arrangements, and commercial contracts.

Aviation

Regulatory matters before the DGCA and the Ministry of Civil Aviation, operator permits, and aviation contracts.

Foreign Investment & Market Entry

FDI and FEMA compliance, entry structures for foreign companies, and government approvals.

Regulatory & Compliance

Licensing, sector-specific regulatory compliance and representation before regulators.

Dispute Resolution & Arbitration

Commercial litigation, domestic and international arbitration, and mediation.

Employment & Labour

Employment contracts and policies, labour code compliance, workplace investigations and employee exits.

Restructuring & Insolvency

Proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, debt restructuring and creditor representation.

Technology & Data Protection

Technology contracts, IT law compliance and data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

Real Estate

Due diligence, acquisition and leasing of commercial property, and real estate documentation.

People

Our Team

Vaibhav S. Kulkarni

Founder

Mumbai & New Delhi

Vaibhav S. Kulkarni is the Founder of VSK & Associates and has over 10 years of experience in legal practice. He advises Indian and foreign clients on corporate and commercial matters, aviation, foreign investment and entry into India, regulatory compliance, dispute resolution and arbitration, employment and labour, restructuring and insolvency, technology and data protection, and real estate.

He holds a B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) degree from NMIMS School of Law and is enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa.
